t: Magnusson 3/8" drive small sized socket rail set is a key addition to any toolkit, providing reliable performance for various fastening applications. Durable, heat-treated chrome vanadium steel construction with a satin finish provides longevity and easy maintenance, allowing for the easy removal of oil and dirt. Includes 8 metric hex end sockets, ranging from 2.5mm to 10mm, each featuring large, hard-stamped size markings for quick identification. Organised on a 180mm rail, the compact socket set is ideal for electricians, mechanics, and DIY enthusiasts working on intricate projects or in confined spaces.
